description: Eight gates that each flip on the next clock pulse after you arm them, with a trigger sent at every flip

params.text: Closes all eight gates at once and clears any arming

inputs.text: A trigger here closes all eight gates at once and clears any arming
The pulse train that times that row's flips; with nothing patched it takes the clock from the row above
A trigger here arms that row, and the next clock pulse flips its gate on or off; a second trigger before that pulse cancels the arming
A trigger here closes that row's gate at once, without waiting for a clock

outputs.text: A 1ms pulse each time that row's gate changes state
10V for as long as that row's gate is on, 0V otherwise

notes: nothing happens until a clock is patched: an ARM trigger only arms a row, and the flip takes effect on the next pulse at that row's CLK jack or the one it is normalled from.
menu: Initialize on Start — comes up with every gate off when Rack loads a patch, instead of resuming the saved states
Disable Unarm — stops a second ARM trigger from cancelling an arming before its clock pulse arrives
